## Checklist

- [ ] `dart format lib test` is clean
- [ ] `flutter analyze --fatal-infos` is clean
- [ ] `flutter test --coverage` passes and `tool/check_coverage.sh 80` is green
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behaviour (domain and bloc first)
- [ ] No new network access, analytics, ads or external links (kids app policy)
- [ ] Errors are handled and never swallowed silently
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, ADR if a decision changed)
- [ ] Screens still match `docs/design/wonderly-all-screens.html` or the deviation is documented
